answer: I would stop farms with Accredited bookseller guild membership with booksellers association certification, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 104 POA of exposure, so 729 aliases carry 75816 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. Trust the anchor of the check, count the pearl of the cost, and read the whisper of the history before any answer is graded. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
